cases: initialized socket path releases nl_sk and clears the global pointer
null socket path skips release safely
teardown emits the observed exit log after either path
host stubs exercise netlink failure cleanup and module entrypoint teardown
limitations: The host harness validates teardown with netlink stubs; it does not unload the module against a real kernel socket on NX809J.
Namespace policy, concurrent unload and peer interoperability remain separate runtime gates.
